SUBJECT: Ford Mustang Cobra, racing preparation referencing Mustang Cobra Trans-Am (1997). The racing kit is an explicitly declared interpretation of period motorsport preparation, not a claim that the stock photo shows a race car: Fotografia originale del modello stradale · Ford Mustang Cobra. Its description: Actual original road-car photograph supplied with the game. Use for exact model identity and generation, not as evidence of a historical racing livery.. Use period racing hardware and bodywork rather than generic modern aero. Input3 is PIXEL STYLE/CAMERA ONLY, never borrow the Fiat Punto body. CRITICAL MODEL ANATOMY: Ford Mustang Cobra R New Edge coupe as reference, tall fixed rear wing, deep front splitter and angular 1999-2000 lamps.. REQUIRED VISIBLE PHYSICAL MODIFICATIONS: retain SN95 Mustang body, broad Trans-Am fenders, low splitter, wide braced rear wing, silver racing wheels; no later Mustang. Do NOT merely recolour the stock sprite: rebuild the listed bumpers, splitter, flares, skirts, wing and competition wheels with believable proportions. The chosen period livery is white blue and red American touring graphics. Keep small sponsor/number panels coherent with period racing; simplify tiny lettering into clean pixel marks without UI text. Where a real race reference is another derivative, preserve the approved road generation, door count and headlight identity; translate the race kit onto the SAME road model, never swap the vehicle. No drivetrain or engine-location change implied by the body. One entire isolated car, front-left three-quarter camera, nose pointing down-left, approximately40%front60%side, straight wheels, realistic body proportions and generous clear margins on a wide3:1 canvas. Transparent background, no cast shadow or ground plane, no scenery, people, multiple views, captions or watermark. STRICT hand-drawn 1990s PC racing game pixel art on a logical320x128 grid: sharp stepped outline, dark one-pixel panel gaps, clean square clusters and compact5-6shade material ramps. No photorealism or photo filter, no3D/vector rendering, antialiasing, smooth gradients, blur, noisy textures, modern giant wheels, modern LED lighting, post-2002 GT3 equipment or mismatched body generations. The rear silhouette and tail lamps must remain recognizable and accurate, with only documented/plausible race-kit extensions.
